t: This is the Guild Church of St Katharine Cree, on the north side of Leadenhall Street near Leadenhall Market. The church was founded in twelve eighty, and the present building dates from sixteen twenty-eight to sixteen thirty. It is named for Catherine of Alexandria, the saint traditionally shown with a wheel. Two notable people are buried here: the great portrait painter Hans Holbein the Younger, and Sir Nicholas Throckmorton, an English diplomat who was ambassador to France and later Scotland, and who played a key role in the relationship between Elizabeth the First and Mary, Queen of Scots.
